author: Guang-Shan Jiang and Chi-Wang Shu
title: Efficient Implementation of Weighted ENO Schemes
role: Classical JS candidate/weight/indicator background; preprint finite-difference convention distinguished from this FV implementation
review_level: NASA-hosted ICASE95-73 preprint selected sections1–3: candidate Table1, optimal Table2, equations2.15–2.16 and3.1–3.9; text layer inspected, not full paper/numerical tables

review.ja: NASA公開プレプリントの節1–3で係数・重み・滑らかさ指標と有限差分の点値の規約を確認。原著の全実験やEuler特性分解を再現したとは表示しません。
review.en: Inspected selected sections1–3 of the NASA preprint for candidates, weights, indicators and finite-difference point-value conventions. Original experiments/Euler characteristic reconstruction are not reproduced.

author: Rafael Borges, Monique Carmona, Bruno Costa and Wai Sun Don
title: An improved weighted essentially non-oscillatory scheme for hyperbolic conservation laws
role: Original WENO-Z attribution and historical scope, not an actually inspected full-text formula source
review_level: Author-institution publication record and abstract inspected; publisher full text returned403; original full paper and numerical experiments not audited

review.ja: 著者所属機関の書誌と抄録を確認。出版社全文は取得不能であり、全文読了・元の実験・指数1の再現は主張しません。実装する指数2の式は別の一次研究論文でも確認しました。
review.en: Inspected the author institution bibliography/abstract. Full publisher text was unavailable; no full-paper audit or replication of original power-one experiments is claimed. The implemented power-two formula was checked in another primary research paper.

author: Bart S. van Lith, Jan H. M. ten Thije Boonkkamp and Wilbert L. IJzerman
title: Embedded WENO: A design strategy to improve existing WENO schemes
role: Actually inspected finite-volume cell-mean derivation of baseline JS/Z candidates, weights and power-two choice; embedded modifications excluded
review_level: Institution-hosted accepted manuscript section2 equations2–15 (PDF pages4–8) and selected section4.2 (PDF page22) text inspected; screenshot requests cache-missed; not a full-paper review

review.ja: 機関公開の著者版でセル平均の式(2)–(3)、候補・線形重み(4)–(7)、JS指標と重み(8)–(13)、Z重み(15)、節4.2の指数2を確認。新規のembedded方式は実装せず、論文PDFも同梱しません。
review.en: Inspected cell-average equations2–3, candidate/linear weights4–7, JS indicators/weights8–13, Z weights15 and selected power-two discussion in section4.2. The paper’s new embedded schemes are not implemented and its PDF is not redistributed.
